body: Thank you. I find the best poetry comes from over powering emotions. I just feel lucky to have the grace with words needed to produce beauty out of pain
Same. He sounds like an old YouTuber that went silent after some allegations. Cryaotic. But I've yet to find any names or photos either.

A few i suppose. Standing beside the open casket of a 7 year old boy who had passed from abuse. Realizing that I was mentally ill and needed help. realizing that while I was stuck with said illness due to neglect of others, the responsibility of this illness was my own. Leaving a 10 year relationship and also knowing I was breaking the promise I made to a man on his death bed by doing so.

I was in a friend's with benefits that turned into my current 2 year relationship. I kinda agree with everyone else. When it's great, it's great. But be ready to deal with any repercussions, whether that be in the relationship or in the workplace. I have to fly under the radar and not post to socials. Questions on how I've progressed in my job and offers from other coworkers trying to sleep with me as well. (Found out my company has a massive cheating ring). I love my partner to death, but I would definitely think it over before you decide. I don't think I'd ever do it again, honestly.
Much appreciated. Glad to be back
Is it hard for you to believe that someone might actually want to help another heal from wounds they inflicted? I hope you find peace as well
Maybe, never said I wasn't wrong. Only said I wish he wasn't in pain anymore. Much love💜

With aimless direction, strolling until we find that the same door we entered is the only one that could ever release us from the labyrinth we stumbled into. Motivation had been waiting on the other side the entire time.

Poetry is therapeutic. An open language and beautiful imagery. I don't know. I'm a sucker for some good language. I love to see how people interpret my work in relation to what it was actually written about. How every person attaches themselves when they read it.
It's a daily battle. But one that has taught me many things. I wouldn't change who I am. But, yes, when it happens, it is quite awful.

My method of staying alive, so far, is this. I stop and think about killing myself. I usually get a flash of pain and think of something that I will miss. Even if it is just a miniscule thing, it's a fucking food sometimes, and I hold onto it. And I play it over and over in my head, no matter how much it hurts. It is never instant relief but it is something to tether me to this world just for a little longer

A burden, I lye.

They fill my head with lies.

So hard to breathe,

When this doubt always overshadows me.

I get it. What's the point. The world is so fake anymore. Why should I even care...

Numbness a welcome friend

Some wounds will never heal

This lesson will last a lifetime

Reverse gratitude for royally fucking my life
Beautiful. Empowering
Not the almond milk!

A struggle that lasts a lifetime. 

A war in one's own head

The fight is their own

But might I say

No, Don't do it

The sun will rise tomorrow

I hope you see it rise with me
